response.text: {"label": "wrong_self_check", "reason": "The 3C frame is received and accepted mid-stop-bit (sub `386 3108000 rx hs 3c`), but uart_send_byte keeps driving the full stop bit before calling wait_tvalid_rise, so tvalid has already risen and fallen. That wait hangs, the A5 frame is never sent (no counterpart to gold `155 ... rx hs a5`), and the 10ms timeout $fatal fires."}
